sources.postFetch:
export PATH=/nix/store/mwcrf3dx41s7dq6rs4nnh35gnnkdbq4y-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/3e4e44fd360dfe114e81e6332a5a058a4b287cb1.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

sources.postFetch:
export PATH=/nix/store/mwcrf3dx41s7dq6rs4nnh35gnnkdbq4y-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/7.1.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

unpackFile "$renamed"

  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."

fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)

  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/0.16.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

sources.postFetch:
export PATH=/nix/store/mwcrf3dx41s7dq6rs4nnh35gnnkdbq4y-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/1.4.2.zip"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

export PATH=/nix/store/mwcrf3dx41s7dq6rs4nnh35gnnkdbq4y-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/v0.7.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/8b81a32.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."

  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

sources.postFetch:
export PATH=/nix/store/mwcrf3dx41s7dq6rs4nnh35gnnkdbq4y-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/v1.10.3.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

export PATH=/nix/store/mwcrf3dx41s7dq6rs4nnh35gnnkdbq4y-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/0.9.3.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

fi

else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/GNET_2_0_8.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/v2.6.0.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

sources.postFetch:
export PATH=/nix/store/mwcrf3dx41s7dq6rs4nnh35gnnkdbq4y-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/3057a2c07061c8d9ffaf77e5442ffd7512ac0133.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

else

mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/v2.8.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."

fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)

  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

sources.postFetch:
export PATH=/nix/store/mwcrf3dx41s7dq6rs4nnh35gnnkdbq4y-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/libnl3_2_26.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

export PATH=/nix/store/mwcrf3dx41s7dq6rs4nnh35gnnkdbq4y-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/libpsl-0.12.0.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

sources.postFetch:
export PATH=/nix/store/mwcrf3dx41s7dq6rs4nnh35gnnkdbq4y-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/v1.0.0.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

export PATH=/nix/store/mwcrf3dx41s7dq6rs4nnh35gnnkdbq4y-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/v0.1.2.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob

  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1

fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/v2015.3.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob

fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)

  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

cd "$unpackDir"

mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob

  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

sources.postFetch:
export PATH=/nix/store/mwcrf3dx41s7dq6rs4nnh35gnnkdbq4y-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/sam-ba_2.16_linux.zip"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

else

fi

sources.postFetch:
export PATH=/nix/store/mwcrf3dx41s7dq6rs4nnh35gnnkdbq4y-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/v0.2.8.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/0.2.16.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/v0.3.18.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

sources.postFetch:
export PATH=/nix/store/mwcrf3dx41s7dq6rs4nnh35gnnkdbq4y-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/v4.5.0.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1

fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)

  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

export PATH=/nix/store/mwcrf3dx41s7dq6rs4nnh35gnnkdbq4y-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/9083ba284d9222541ce7da8dc87d5a27ef5cc592.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/1.0.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/v1.8.1.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

export PATH=/nix/store/mwcrf3dx41s7dq6rs4nnh35gnnkdbq4y-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/gmock-1.7.0.zip"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/324ea173d0a4d90e0e97c464a6ad33f80c9587a8.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/v1.0.2.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

fi

sources.postFetch:
export PATH=/nix/store/mwcrf3dx41s7dq6rs4nnh35gnnkdbq4y-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/mono-addins-1.2.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/329ae2b.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)

  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."

fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)

  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/9847b93751a5fbaf227b893d172cee0104ac6427.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"

  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi

  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

sources.postFetch:
export PATH=/nix/store/mwcrf3dx41s7dq6rs4nnh35gnnkdbq4y-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/v1.2.3.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

renamed="$TMPDIR/6c54cb57ea406ff6354256a4847e37298194478f.tar.gz"

  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

export PATH=/nix/store/mwcrf3dx41s7dq6rs4nnh35gnnkdbq4y-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/0.4.5.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

export PATH=/nix/store/mwcrf3dx41s7dq6rs4nnh35gnnkdbq4y-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/v1.2.0.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

export PATH=/nix/store/mwcrf3dx41s7dq6rs4nnh35gnnkdbq4y-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/0.8.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi
